address: 702, 7F, K11 Musea, 18 Salisbury Road, Tsim Sha Tsui, Hong Kong, Hong Kong SAR China
bio: It may have moved to a swanky mall in 2020, but this household name in Shanghainese food has been on the radar of gastronomes for over two decades. The room is spread across two floors with a modern take on 1930s Shanghai charm. Apart from drunken chicken, and stir-fried river shrimps, try also their cold appetiser sliced pork dressed in garlic sauce – the paper-thin pork is springy in texture, and its richness is balanced by garlic and soy....
